title: Structural Limits of OHLCV-Based Intraday Momentum Signals in MNQ Futures: A Systematic Falsification Study
one_line: Testing 14 families of 5-minute OHLCV signals on MNQ (Dec 2021-Aug 2025) with walk-forward and 2-point friction, none passed: most had gross edges of 0.07-1.5 points per trade, below costs; only 60-75 minute regime-based holds cleared the bar.

findings.statement: No candidate signal passed all five criteria (net t ≥ 2, ≥30 OOS trades per fold, positive net, same direction 2023-2025, permutation p < 0.001).
findings.evidence: MNQ 5-min RTH, 947 days, walk-forward with 2023/2024/2025 OOS folds, 2.0-point round-trip friction.

findings.statement: Eleven families had maximum gross returns of only 0.07-1.50 points per trade — below the friction floor.
findings.evidence: Includes volume spikes, gap fill fades, Asia range expansion, event-day trend.

findings.statement: ORB long (bar+15) cleared costs but not significance: net +2.82 points, t = 0.88, 447 OOS trades.
Asia range expansion and Asia liquidity-grab fade were strongly NEGATIVE (t = -11.5 and -14.1).
findings.evidence: Signals ran against their intended direction.

findings.statement: Only the two 'positive controls' with 60-75 minute holds and regime detection cleared friction (OOS t = 3.1 and 4.3).
findings.evidence: But both have selection-bias / timing-robustness caveats (one flips sign under a 1-bar delay).

why.pattern: Methodology / market efficiency: single-bar 5-minute signals from public OHLCV can't clear ~1-2 points of gross edge needed to beat costs in MNQ.
why.mechanism: Competitive markets arbitrage simple short-horizon patterns below transaction costs; longer holds escape the per-trade cost ceiling.

reported_results.headline: 0 of 14 signal families passed; most gross edges below a 2-point friction floor.
key_stats: ORB long bar+15: net +2.82 pts, t = 0.88
reported_results.costs_included: 2.0 points round trip MNQ, fixed nominal.

tradable_edge: No new strategy. A hurdle for every intraday idea we test on NQ: average gross edge must clearly exceed ~2 NQ points per round trip, and short 5-minute single-bar signals (like the tight-range breakout and gap fades) are likely below it. Favour 60+ minute holds.
angles: Apply the 5-criteria pass test to our NQ tests (T4 tight-range breakout, gap fades)
Report gross edge per trade in points vs cost for every NQ strategy
data_fit: Same instrument and data source family as Pablo's NQ data (NinjaTrader).
caveats: Single independent author; earlier versions contained errors (corrected).
Continuous contract without roll adjustment; fixed nominal friction across a doubling of price.
